facts.content: Patient has had generalized aches and fatigue for 6 weeks.
Symptoms began approximately 2 weeks after returning from a US holiday at the end of January or early February.
facts.source_text: Onset ≈2 wks after return from US holiday (end Jan/early Feb)

facts.content: Associated symptoms include decreased energy, mild headaches, decreased appetite with smaller portions, transient calf rash in mid-February, arthralgia affecting shoulders, back, hips, and knees.
